inputs.description: Input trace file or directory paths (positional arguments)

input_format.description: Input trace format (currently only 'ctf' is supported)

no_delta.description: Do not print time delta between consecutive events

names.description: Field names to print: options include 'payload', 'args', 'arg', 'none', 'all', 'scope', 'header', 'context', 'ctx'; defaults to ['payload','context']

fields.description: Additional fields to print: options include 'all', 'trace', 'trace:hostname', 'trace:domain', 'trace:procname', 'trace:vpid', 'loglevel'

clock_cycles.description: Disregard internal clock offset (use raw value)

clock_gmt.description: Print clock in GMT timezone (default: local)

stream_intersection.description: Only print events when all streams are active

debug_info_dir.description: Directory to look for debug info files

debug_info_full_path.description: Show full debug info source and binary paths
